purpose: Retrospective development comparison, not an untouched holdout or proof of tradeable edge
refit: At each UTC month boundary using only rows whose assumed outcome availability precedes the boundary

moneyline: elo log odds minus market log odds
spread: EWMA neutral margin plus home line
total: EWMA expected total minus market total

featureTransforms: Mean and standard deviation from training rows only; clip standardized inputs to +/-3; no variable selection
baseline: Power de-vig for moneyline, proportional de-vig for spread/total; archived closing quotes only
primaryMetric: Pooled paired log-loss gain versus market across all 15 sport-market cells; no cherry-picked promotion
secondaryMetrics: one-unit paper return at recorded closing price, including pushes
uncertainty: UTC-week clustered approximate normal 95% intervals; report dependence and normal-approximation limitations
promotion: Never from this retrospective experiment. Require separately approved prospective capture and positive evidence against the contemporaneous market before any model/risk allocation change.
limits: All these historical periods have already been inspected in prior research.
Historical quote observation/publication timestamps and actual game finish timestamps are absent.
24-hour outcome delay is a conservative modeling assumption, not certified source availability.
Closing-price evaluation cannot prove the price could have been executed; no opener backtest or CLV claim.
Historical data revisions, missing games and bookmaker settlement differences can affect results.
No paid calls, production model changes, bets, or collector activation.
